name: Circling Offense [Combat, Selfless, Teamwork]
body:
You are skilled at approaching large foes with an ally in a way that makes it difficult for your foes to find an advantage against your ally, creating a zone of relative safety for your allies to circle and attack from within, while punishing those who might strike back.

Prerequisite(s): Dodge, Mobility, base attack bonus +3.

Benefit(s): Your allies receive a +1 dodge bonus to Armor Class against attacks of opportunity provoked by moving through a creature’s reach, provided the creature is of a larger size category than them and provided you are within the creature’s reach. If a creature that your ally is receiving this dodge bonus against attacks them and misses with the attack, it provokes attacks of opportunity from you.
